svg.aria-label: Animated overview: Claude Code runs natively in tmux on your computer and asks to run go test; the request is encrypted and crosses a relay you host, which sees only ciphertext; you approve it on your phone; the tests run on the computer and the results reach the phone; the phone opens the live terminal of the same session; the next message is sent from the phone and appears in the terminal.
